description: This file contains core application logic for the Notesnook project, including backup management, feature toggles, user account verification, and navigation utilities.

methods.name: introduceFeatures
methods.description: Checks current URL hash and displays feature dialogs for features not yet enabled.

methods.name: createBackup
methods.description: Creates a backup of the application data with options for rescue mode, verification, and background operation.

methods.name: selectBackupFile
methods.description: Opens a file picker dialog for selecting backup files.

methods.name: importBackup
methods.description: Imports a backup file selected via file picker.

methods.name: restoreBackupFile
methods.description: Restores application data from a specified backup file, handling legacy and modern formats.

methods.name: restoreWithProgress
methods.description: Performs backup restoration with progress reporting.

methods.name: verifyAccount
methods.description: Prompts user to verify their account password.

methods.name: totalSubscriptionConsumed
methods.description: Calculates the percentage of subscription time consumed by the user.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Imports backup data into the database and shows success or error messages.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user after optionally creating a backup.

methods.name: createSetDefaultHomepageMenuItem
methods.description: Creates a menu item for setting a page as the default homepage.

methods.name: checkFeature
methods.description: Checks if a feature is available and optionally shows upgrade dialog or toast.

methods.name: withFeatureCheck
methods.description: Wraps a callback with a feature availability check.

methods.name: resetFeatures
methods.description: Resets feature toggles to default states based on availability.

methods.name: scheduleExpiredNotesDeletion
methods.description: Schedules daily deletion of expired notes.
